notes.title: Update 1.3.2
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added 2 new Neck items.
[*] Added a new crafting recipe for 1 of said Neck items.
[*] Added ???????
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed the fishing rod staying in the player's hand after respawning if they died while fishing.
[*] Fixed the cave inside the fissure near Jarde to cull objects incorrectly.
[*] Fixed targets with no level still displaying their stats (which would all be 0).
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.1
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fishing has been added.
[*]Added new items and quests, related to this new activity.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed some NPCs using an incorrect eye texture.
[*]Fixed the intro fading out too fast when creating a new character.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.3.0
notes.content:
Despite the last regular update stating it would be the final update, here is another one!

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new location: Poporia Island (Lv.10-11).
[*] Added 1 new dungeon: Poporia Tower.
[*] Added several new quests, items and enemies along with the mentioned location and dungeon.
[*] Added new ranged attacks to several enemies, along with new animations.
[*] Added a new model and animation set for all snakes.
[*] Some UI elements have been updated.
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Some UI elements have been updated.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed spelling errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.16
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now fast travel using the map to some select locations after visiting them for the first time.
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some HUD elements are now larger, for clarity.
[*]The font size of the tooltip now scales with screen resolution.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.14
notes.content:
[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed game options not saving correctly, resulting in HUD always starting as off.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.13
notes.content:

[list]

[/list]

[list]

[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]

[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.12
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]

[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]

[*] Improved performance for all graphic tiers.

notes.title: Update 1.2.11
notes.content:
This is officially the last regular update to be released for Sea of Blood. Take on this final challenge, or die trying!

[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new level 20 World Boss.
[*] Added 1 new Ring item.
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Venom Spiders now poison the player.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed several spelling errors.
[*] Fixed the Completionist achievement no longer triggering correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.10
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added bows as a new weapon type.
[*] Added 13 new Bow items.
[*] Added 3 new Skills (requires a bow).
[*] Added new animations for player Skills.
[*] Added an FPS counter to the options window.
[/list]

[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*] Pets now have larger range of attack.
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing attack animations for reeters, spiders and snakes.
[*] Fixed blood elementals resetting their idle animation too quickly.
[*] Fixed level up popups not disappearing if not connected to steam.
[*] Fixed some enemy levels not displaying the correct number.
[*] Fixed a bug where returning to the main menu could result in the character select menu not working correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.9
notes.content:
[h2]New[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now access the cellar of the church in Forst.
[*]Added new level 11 enemies to Phem.
[*]Added 2 new quests.
[*]Added 2 new Ring items.
[*]Added 1 new Neck item.
[/list]
[h2]Tweaks[/h2]
[list]
[*]You can now upgrade the Magician's Hat.
[*]Your steam status now displays your current location in game.
[*]Cowo will now put up holiday decorations on certain days of the year.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.2.8
